title: BoxBoy! + BoxGirl!
subtitle: A few boxes can become a route
summary: BoxBoy! + BoxGirl! is HAL Laboratory's puzzle-platform game, released for Nintendo Switch on 26 April 2019.
body: BoxBoy! + BoxGirl! is HAL Laboratory's puzzle-platform game, released for Nintendo Switch on 26 April 2019. Qbby and Qucy cross small stages by creating chains of boxes from their bodies. Those simple shapes can bridge a gap, hold down a switch or protect a character from a hazard. The fourth game in the series adds a dedicated two-player campaign, giving the same minimal set of objects another purpose when two people must coordinate their positions and the structures they build.

Each stage limits how many boxes can be produced in one chain. The challenge is to find a shape and position that solve the obstacle within that allowance. A chain can be carried, extended or set down, so the solution often depends on understanding how its placement changes what the character can reach next. Collectible crowns and rewards for economical solutions encourage another attempt after reaching the exit, turning a route that merely works into one built with fewer unnecessary pieces.

A Tale for Two gives both players their own boxes and asks them to cooperate across its obstacles. It can also be played alone by switching between the characters. A third campaign introduces the taller Qudy, whose rectangular form changes the shapes available and the spaces they can occupy. Across 270 stages, the game varies the relationship between body, box and empty space. Its clear drawings leave the movement of those few elements to explain both the problem and the eventual solution.
